title: RPF Constable & Sub-Inspector (SI) Guide: Physical Standards & Exam Blueprint
summary: Complete preparation guide for Railway Protection Force (RPF) Constable and Sub-Inspector posts: CBT syllabus, physical efficiency tests (PET), and medical criteria.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) under the Ministry of Railways conduct centralized recruitments through RRBs for Constables and Sub-Inspectors (SI). The RPF is mandated with protecting railway passengers, passenger areas, and railway infrastructure nationwide. Offering central police perks, railway passes, and fast-track promotions, RPF recruitments attract millions of aspirants.

## Eligibility Criteria

| Post | Educational Qualification | Nationality Criteria |
|---|---|---|
| **RPF Sub-Inspector (SI) (Executive)** | Graduate from a recognized University in any stream. | Citizen of India. |
| **RPF Constable (Executive)** | 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognized Board. | Citizen of India. |

## Age Limit & Category Relaxations

| Post | Category | Standard Age Range | Age Relaxation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **RPF Constable** | General / EWS | 18 - 28 Years | Nil (0 Years) |
| **RPF Constable** | OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) | 18 - 28 Years | 3 Years (Up to 31 Years) |
| **RPF Constable** | SC / ST | 18 - 28 Years | 5 Years (Up to 33 Years) |
| **RPF Sub-Inspector** | General / EWS | 20 - 28 Years | Nil (0 Years) |
| **RPF Sub-Inspector** | OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) | 20 - 28 Years | 3 Years (Up to 31 Years) |
| **RPF Sub-Inspector** | SC / ST | 20 - 28 Years | 5 Years (Up to 33 Years) |
| **Both Posts** | Ex-Servicemen | As per central rules | 3 years after deduction of military service |

## Computer Based Test (CBT) Pattern

| Section | Number of Questions | Maximum Marks | Time Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| **General Awareness** | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | Combined 90 Minutes |
| **Arithmetic (Mathematics)** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | (1/3rd Negative Marking per wrong answer) |
| **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | Qualifying Cutoff: UR/OBC - 35%, SC/ST - 30% |
| **Total** | **120 Questions** | **120 Marks** | **90 Minutes** |

## Physical Measurement Test (PMT)

| Category | Male Height | Female Height | Male Chest (Unexpanded) | Male Chest (Expanded) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **UR / OBC** | 165 cm | 157 cm | 80 cm | 85 cm (5 cm expansion) |
| **SC / ST** | 160 cm | 152 cm | 76.2 cm | 81.2 cm (5 cm expansion) |
| **Garhwalis, Gorkhas, Marathas, Dogras, Kumaonis** | 163 cm | 155 cm | 80 cm | 85 cm |

## Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

### For RPF Constable (Executive)
| Event | Male Requirement | Female Requirement | Chances Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1600 Meters Run** | 5 Minutes 45 Seconds | Not Applicable | Only 1 Chance |
| **800 Meters Run** | Not Applicable | 3 Minutes 40 Seconds | Only 1 Chance |
| **Long Jump** | 14 Feet | 9 Feet | 2 Chances |
| **High Jump** | 4 Feet | 3 Feet | 2 Chances |

### For RPF Sub-Inspector (Executive)
| Event | Male Requirement | Female Requirement | Chances Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1600 Meters Run** | 6 Minutes 30 Seconds | Not Applicable | Only 1 Chance |
| **800 Meters Run** | Not Applicable | 4 Minutes 00 Seconds | Only 1 Chance |
| **Long Jump** | 12 Feet | 9 Feet | 2 Chances |
| **High Jump** | 3 Feet 9 Inches | 3 Feet | 2 Chances |

## Comprehensive Preparation Strategy

| Phase | Action Plan & Regimen |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Daily Physical Conditioning** | RPF Constable's 1600m in 5:45 is one of the toughest running standards in India. Start interval running (400m laps) 4 months ahead. Practice long jump and high jump technique twice a week to avoid foul attempts. |
| **Phase 2: Master 50 Marks in General Awareness** | Focus on Indian History, Geography, Polity, General Science, and Sports events. Current affairs of the last 8 months carry major weightage. |
| **Phase 3: High-Speed Arithmetic & Reasoning** | Master Number Systems, Percentage, Ratio, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Profit & Loss. In reasoning, solve coding-decoding, blood relations, non-verbal figures, and analogies. |
| **Phase 4: Full-Length Speed Drills** | Solve 120 questions within 80 minutes to keep a 10-minute buffer for reviewing marked answers. Maintain accuracy above 90% to overcome the 1/3rd negative penalty. |

Success in RPF requires clearing both the high-cutoff written CBT and the rigorous physical running benchmarks. Train your physical stamina and written speed hand-in-hand to earn your uniform.
